options.label: Icathian Surprise explodes on the target

notes: The explosion after Kog'Maw dies is off unless "Icathian Surprise explodes on the target" is set. It is then added to the combo once, and never to damage per second.
Caustic Spittle lowers the target's armor and magic resist for what follows it in the combo, until its duration runs out. Its own damage is dealt before the reduction.

rules.note: Casting Bio-Arcane Barrage empowers the attacks that follow it in the combo, until its duration runs out. For damage per second, set "Bio-Arcane Barrage active".
